# Synthesis

Field's own signal graph — the part of the audio stack that makes samples rather than arranging them. One value type carries the whole thing: `Signal` is a block-rendered mono source, `SignalProcessor` is a `Signal` that reads another one, and `/` chains the two, so `saw / OnePole(800.p)` is a filtered sawtooth and nothing else had to be declared. Control values are `Param`, which a plain number becomes with `.p`, and which can itself be driven by a signal. `audio { … }` closes a mono or stereo graph into an `AudioPatchSpec`; return one as a box's last expression and the box stays lit for as long as it is making sound. Underneath is a shared OpenAL engine, one process-wide, with warm-up passes available so the first buffer is not also the JIT's first look at your graph. On top of the oscillator / filter / effect / envelope families sit three larger things that are not Field's own DSP: **Faust**, whose compiler is embedded as WebAssembly and turns a `#faust` box into a running node in the same graph; the **dough** ports, hand-rolled float math whose inaccuracy is the character rather than a defect; and the **spectral** and **granular** layers, which are Field's own. `Visualizers.kt` is how you look at any of it — every function there is an extension on a type declared in this category. Start from `synth.kt`, which is the terse surface a box actually imports; [Sound: from a pattern to something you can hear](../sound.md) is the prose, [Faust](../faust.md) is the embedded compiler with worked examples, and [DoughDSP: hear the primitives](../dough_dsp_sound.md) plays the ports.

### DoughMath { #doughdsp-kt-doughmath }

[<code class="highlight"><span class="k">object</span> <span class="nc">DoughMath</span></code>](source/jvmMain/afield/four/synth/DoughDsp/#L70)

dough's hand-rolled float math. Cheaper and less accurate than `kotlin.math`; the inaccuracy is audible and is part of the character of [`ChamberlinLowpass`](synthesis.md#doughdsp-kt-chamberlinlowpass) and [`Phaser`](synthesis.md#doughdsp-kt-phaser), which recompute coefficients with these on every sample.

class="nc">LiveGraphInspectable</span></code>](source/jvmMain/afield/four/synth/DoughDsp/#L206)

Jon Dattorro's plate reverb: a pre-delay and input-diffusion chain feeding a figure-of-eight tank of two cross-coupled halves, each with its own all-pass diffusers and damping lowpass. The stereo image comes from summing seven taps per side at points scattered through the tank, so it is decorrelated rather than merely panned — this is what makes it sound different from [`FreeVerb`](synthesis.md#effects-kt-freeverb) and [`SpringReverb`](synthesis.md#effects-kt-springreverb).

### Phaser { #doughdsp-kt-phaser }

[<code class="highlight"><span class="k">class</span> <span class="nf">Phaser</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">val</span> <span class="n">rate</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">Param</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nc">Param</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mf">0.5f</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="k">val</span> <span class="n">depth</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">Param</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nc">Param</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mf">0.5f</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="k">val</span> <span class="n">center</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">Param</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nc">Param</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1000f</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="k">val</span> <span class="n">sweep</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">Param</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nc">Param</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">600f</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="k">val</span> <span class="n">mix</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">Param</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nc">Param</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1f</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">SignalProcessor</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">)</span></code>](source/jvmMain/afield/four/synth/DoughDsp/#L466)

Two cascaded notch filters swept by a sine LFO, the second offset 282 Hz above the first. Detuning is exponential (in cents), so the sweep sounds even across the range, and `depth` widens the notches by lowering their Q rather than by moving them further.

### ChamberlinLowpass { #doughdsp-kt-chamberlinlowpass }

[<code class="highlight"><span class="k">class</span> <span class="nf">ChamberlinLowpass</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">val</span> <span class="n">cutoff</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">Param</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nc">Param</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1000f</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="k">val</span> <span class="n">resonance</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">Param</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nc">Param</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">0f</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">SignalProcessor</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">)</span></code>](source/jvmMain/afield/four/synth/DoughDsp/#L569)

Two-pole Chamberlin-style state-variable lowpass, in the exact form strudel/superdough uses. Distinct from [`SVF`](synthesis.md#filters-kt-svf) (trapezoidal, zero-delay feedback) in both topology and, more audibly, in the resonance curve: damping is `0.5^((resonance + 0.125) / 0.125)`, so the useful range is squeezed into the top of the `resonance` knob and it snarls rather than whistles as it approaches self-oscillation.

| Declaration | Summary |
| --- | --- |

[<code class="highlight"><span class="k">class</span> <span class="nf">SoftDistort</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">val</span> <span class="n">amount</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">Param</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nc">Param</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1f</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="k">val</span> <span class="n">postGain</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">Param</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nc">Param</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1f</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">SignalProcessor</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">)</span></code>](source/jvmMain/afield/four/synth/DoughDsp/#L755)

The soft clipper from superdough: `y = (1+k)x / (1 + k|x|)` with `k = e^amount - 1`, so `amount` maps to drive exponentially and the output stays bounded by `(1+k)/k` however hard it is pushed.

## ParamQuery.kt { #paramquery-kt }

The synth-facing head of the graph-query layer: turn a `PathSet` into a set of *drivable
parameters*.

Two kinds of slot qualify, behind one `ParamBinding` interface:

 - a native [`Param`](synthesis.md#signal-kt-param) (base + supplier + modulation), grouped by identity so several
   addresses for one Param collapse into a single entry with `aliases`;
 - any writable numeric property, wrapped in a `ScalarPathState` that gives a plain
   `Int`/`Float`/`Double`/… field the same base/supplier/modulation semantics, coercing
   back to the field's declared type on write.

That second case is the interesting one: it makes *any* object's numeric field
modulatable, which is why the generic query core underneath knows nothing
about audio.

This used to end "Only this file touches `Runloop`". Checked while auditing this package's KDoc
for the sound-path map, and it is not true — `AudioReturnValue`, `PatPatternReturnValue` and
`BooleanNetworkSequencing` all reach for `Runloop.runLoop` too. What is true is narrower, and is
what the sentence was reaching for: the *generic query core* — path resolution, grouping,
`ScalarPathState` — has no runloop dependency at all, and this file is where the runloop-bound
half of the param layer is confined.

`src/jvmMain/kotlin/afield/four/synth/ParamQuery.kt` — [read the source](source/jvmMain/afield/four/synth/ParamQuery/)

**Used in:** [Querying object graphs](../graph_query.md)

[<code class="highlight"><span class="k">interface</span> <span class="nc">StereoRenderable</span></code>](source/jvmMain/afield/four/synth/Signal/#L693)
